comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Shipped invalidation on dismiss and mark-all-read; badge now zeroes immediately in staging.

content.text: Shipped invalidation on dismiss and mark-all-read; badge now zeroes immediately in staging.

The sidebar notifications badge shows the unread count. Opening the panel and dismissing the final unread item clears the list UI, but the badge number stays at 1 (or whatever it was) until logout or hard reload.
Badge should hit zero when unread drops to zero. The dismiss mutation removed the item from the list query but never wrote unreadCount: 0 into the badge cache entry.
Stale badge makes people keep opening an empty inbox. Fix was to invalidate notifications.unreadCount on every mark-read/dismiss and to derive the badge from that query only.
